#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Emit the shipping artifacts from a verified manifest.

    SoundBank.luau  data only, one entry per role   -> src/shared/Config/
    Sfx.luau        the runtime helper              -> src/shared/
    install.lua     builds the Sounds in the place  -> execute_luau

The bank is DATA and the helper is CODE, which is the same split every other
tunable in a well-structured game project uses. Nothing downstream is allowed to
hardcode an asset id.

install.lua exists so a place with no Rojo sync can still hear the result. It
is not the shipping path; the module pair is.

    emit_bank.py work/manifest.json --out work/
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

BANK_HEAD = """--!strict
-- SoundBank: every sound this game uses, by role.
--
-- GENERATED by the roblox-sfx skill from a manifest whose every entry was
-- loaded and measured in Studio. Do not hand-edit: re-run the skill.
--
-- Every id below is a free Roblox Creator Store asset used BY ID. Nothing was
-- uploaded, so none of this touches the Open Cloud audio quota.
--
-- `length` is Sound.TimeLength as measured in Studio, never the toolbox
-- listing's duration field, which is wrong often enough to be dangerous.

export type Entry = {
\tid: number,
\tlength: number,
\tvolume: number,
\tlooped: boolean,
\tname: string,
\tcreator: string,
}

local SoundBank: { [string]: Entry } = {
"""

BANK_TAIL = """}

return SoundBank
"""

SFX = '''--!strict
-- Sfx: play a sound by ROLE, never by id.
--
-- Standing rule: cosmetics can never break gameplay. Every entry point here is
-- pcall-isolated and fails inert - a missing sound must never stop a shot from
-- firing or a sheep from moving.

local ContentProvider = game:GetService("ContentProvider")
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local SoundBank = require(script.Parent.Config.SoundBank)

local Sfx = {}

local TEMPLATES = "SfxTemplates"
local TAIL = 0.5 -- grace after TimeLength before the clone is destroyed

local function templates(): Folder
\tlocal folder = SoundService:FindFirstChild(TEMPLATES)
\tif not folder then
\t\tfolder = Instance.new("Folder")
\t\tfolder.Name = TEMPLATES
\t\tfolder.Parent = SoundService
\tend
\treturn folder :: Folder
end

local function template(role: string): Sound?
\tlocal entry = SoundBank[role]
\tif not entry then
\t\twarn(`[Sfx] no such role: {role}`)
\t\treturn nil
\tend
\tlocal folder = templates()
\tlocal existing = folder:FindFirstChild(role)
\tif existing and existing:IsA("Sound") then
\t\treturn existing
\tend
\tlocal sound = Instance.new("Sound")
\tsound.Name = role
\tsound.SoundId = `rbxassetid://{entry.id}`
\tsound.Volume = entry.volume
\tsound.Looped = entry.looped
\tsound.Parent = folder
\treturn sound
end

--- Warm every asset. Yields, so call it from a spawned thread at startup.
function Sfx.preload()
\tlocal list = {}
\tfor role in SoundBank do
\t\tlocal t = template(role)
\t\tif t then
\t\t\ttable.insert(list, t)
\t\tend
\tend
\tpcall(function()
\t\tContentProvider:PreloadAsync(list)
\tend)
end

--- Play `role`. `parent` may be a BasePart or Attachment for 3D sound, or nil
--- for a flat 2D sound. `pitchVary` is a half-range, so 0.1 gives 0.9x - 1.1x.
--- Returns the playing Sound, or nil if anything at all went wrong.
function Sfx.play(role: string, parent: Instance?, pitchVary: number?): Sound?
\tlocal ok, result = pcall(function(): Sound?
\t\tlocal source = template(role)
\t\tif not source then
\t\t\treturn nil
\t\tend
\t\tlocal entry = SoundBank[role]
\t\tlocal clone = source:Clone()
\t\tif pitchVary and pitchVary > 0 then
\t\t\tclone.PlaybackSpeed = 1 + (math.random() * 2 - 1) * pitchVary
\t\tend
\t\tclone.Parent = parent or SoundService
\t\tclone:Play()
\t\tif not entry.looped then
\t\t\t-- PlaybackSpeed stretches real time, so scale the lifetime by it.
\t\t\tDebris:AddItem(clone, entry.length / math.max(clone.PlaybackSpeed, 0.01) + TAIL)
\t\tend
\t\treturn clone
\tend)
\tif not ok then
\t\twarn(`[Sfx] {role} failed inert: {result}`)
\t\treturn nil
\tend
\treturn result
end

--- Stop a looping sound started with Sfx.play.
function Sfx.stop(sound: Sound?)
\tif sound then
\t\tpcall(function()
\t\t\tsound:Stop()
\t\t\tsound:Destroy()
\t\tend)
\tend
end

return Sfx
'''

INSTALL_HEAD = """-- roblox-sfx: build the verified sounds straight into this place.
-- Generated. Creates SoundService/SFX/<role>, ready to hear immediately.
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local root = SoundService:FindFirstChild("SFX")
if not root then
\troot = Instance.new("Folder")
\troot.Name = "SFX"
\troot.Parent = SoundService
end
root:ClearAllChildren()

local BANK = {
"""

INSTALL_TAIL = """}

for _, e in ipairs(BANK) do
\tlocal s = Instance.new("Sound")
\ts.Name = e.role
\ts.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(e.id)
\ts.Volume = e.volume
\ts.Looped = e.looped
\ts.Parent = root
end

return string.format("installed %d sounds under SoundService.SFX", #BANK)
"""


TOUR_HEAD = """-- roblox-sfx: play the whole bank out loud, spaced by each sound's real length.
-- Generated. Studio plays Sounds in edit mode, so this needs no playtest.
-- Returns immediately and schedules the rest with task.delay, because
-- execute_luau drops its output if the script yields.
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local root = SoundService:FindFirstChild("SFX")
if not root then
\treturn "run install.lua first"
end

local TOUR = {
"""

TOUR_TAIL = """}

local GAP = 0.4
local at = 0
for _, e in ipairs(TOUR) do
\tlocal offset = at
\ttask.delay(offset, function()
\t\tlocal s = root:FindFirstChild(e.role)
\t\tif s and s:IsA("Sound") then
\t\t\ts.TimePosition = 0
\t\t\ts:Play()
\t\t\tprint(string.format("%5.1fs  %s", offset, e.role))
\t\tend
\tend)
\tat += e.length + GAP
end

return string.format("touring %d sounds over %.1f seconds - listen", #TOUR, at)
"""


def write_lf(path, text: str) -> None:
    """newline="" so Windows does not write CRLF. The .luau files here land in a
    repo whose stylua gate normalises to LF, and a CRLF file fails that gate as
    entirely unformatted."""
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


def lua_str(s: str) -> str:
    return '"' + s.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace('"', '\\"') + '"'


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("manifest")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="work")
    ap.add_argument("--allow-holes", action="store_true",
                    help="emit even though roles are unfilled (you will ship a silent role)")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    m = json.loads(Path(a.manifest).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    if m.get("unfilled") and not a.allow_holes:
        names = ", ".join(u["role"] for u in m["unfilled"])
        raise SystemExit(f"refusing to emit: {len(m['unfilled'])} unfilled role(s): {names}\n"
                         f"fix the search or pass --allow-holes deliberately.")

    out = Path(a.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    rows = []
    inst = []
    tour = []
    for s in sorted(m["sounds"], key=lambda x: x["role"]):
        tour.append(f"\t{{ role = {lua_str(s['role'])}, length = {s['length']} }},")
        rows.append(
            f"\t[{lua_str(s['role'])}] = {{\n"
            f"\t\tid = {s['id']},\n"
            f"\t\tlength = {s['length']},\n"
            f"\t\tvolume = {s['volume']},\n"
            f"\t\tlooped = {str(s['looped']).lower()},\n"
            f"\t\tname = {lua_str(s['name'])},\n"
            f"\t\tcreator = {lua_str(s['creator'])},\n"
            f"\t}},"
        )
        inst.append(
            f"\t{{ role = {lua_str(s['role'])}, id = {s['id']}, "
            f"volume = {s['volume']}, looped = {str(s['looped']).lower()} }},"
        )

    write_lf(out / "SoundBank.luau", BANK_HEAD + "\n".join(rows) + "\n" + BANK_TAIL)
    write_lf(out / "Sfx.luau", SFX)
    write_lf(out / "install.lua", INSTALL_HEAD + "\n".join(inst) + "\n" + INSTALL_TAIL)
    write_lf(out / "tour.lua", TOUR_HEAD + "\n".join(tour) + "\n" + TOUR_TAIL)

    print(f"{out/'SoundBank.luau'}  {len(rows)} roles  -> src/shared/Config/")
    print(f"{out/'Sfx.luau'}                       -> src/shared/")
    print(f"{out/'install.lua'}      -> execute_luau, to hear it in this place now")
    print(f"{out/'tour.lua'}         -> execute_luau, plays the whole bank in order")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Turn candidates.json into the two Luau calls that verify them in Studio.

TWO calls, not one, and that is not a style choice. `execute_luau` drops all
output if the script yields at all, and a Sound does not resolve its length in
the same frame you set SoundId. So:

    call 1  probe.lua   creates every candidate Sound and returns immediately
    call 2  report.lua  reads IsLoaded and TimeLength a moment later

Anything still IsLoaded=false in call 2 gets one more report.lua before it is
treated as a genuine failure (unresolvable id, deleted asset, or audio the
place is not permitted to use).

    emit_probe.py work/candidates.json --out work/
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
from pathlib import Path

PROBE = """-- roblox-sfx: create every candidate Sound. Generated, do not hand-edit.
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

local root = SoundService:FindFirstChild("SFXProbe")
if not root then
\troot = Instance.new("Folder")
\troot.Name = "SFXProbe"
\troot.Parent = SoundService
end
root:ClearAllChildren()

local SPEC = {spec}

local made = 0
for _, role in ipairs(SPEC) do
\tlocal folder = Instance.new("Folder")
\tfolder.Name = role.role
\tfolder.Parent = root
\tfor _, id in ipairs(role.ids) do
\t\tlocal s = Instance.new("Sound")
\t\ts.Name = tostring(id)
\t\ts.SoundId = "rbxassetid://" .. tostring(id)
\t\ts.Volume = 0
\t\ts.Parent = folder
\t\tmade += 1
\tend
end

return string.format("created %d sounds across %d roles", made, #SPEC)
"""

REPORT = """-- roblox-sfx: measure what actually loaded. Generated, do not hand-edit.
-- TimeLength is the ONLY trustworthy duration in this pipeline.
local root = game:GetService("SoundService"):FindFirstChild("SFXProbe")
if not root then
\treturn "NO PROBE - run probe.lua first"
end

local lines = {}
for _, folder in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
\tfor _, s in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
\t\ttable.insert(lines, string.format(
\t\t\t"%s,%s,%s,%.3f",
\t\t\tfolder.Name, s.Name, tostring(s.IsLoaded), s.TimeLength
\t\t))
\tend
end
table.sort(lines)
return table.concat(lines, "\\n")
"""

AUDITION = """-- roblox-sfx: play one candidate out loud in edit mode, for a human ear.
-- Studio plays Sounds in edit mode, so this needs no playtest.
local root = game:GetService("SoundService"):FindFirstChild("SFXProbe")
if not root then return "NO PROBE" end

local ROLE, ID, VOLUME = {role}, {id}, {volume}

local folder = root:FindFirstChild(ROLE)
if not folder then return "no such role: " .. ROLE end
local s = folder:FindFirstChild(tostring(ID))
if not s then return "no such id under " .. ROLE end

for _, other in ipairs(root:GetDescendants()) do
\tif other:IsA("Sound") and other.IsPlaying then other:Stop() end
end

s.Volume = VOLUME
s.TimePosition = 0
s:Play()
return string.format("playing %s / %s  (%.3fs)", ROLE, s.Name, s.TimeLength)
"""


def luau_table(spec: list[dict]) -> str:
    parts = []
    for role in spec:
        ids = ", ".join(str(i) for i in role["ids"])
        parts.append('\n\t{ role = "%s", ids = { %s } },' % (role["role"], ids))
    return "{" + "".join(parts) + "\n}"


def main() -> int:
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    ap.add_argument("candidates")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default="work")
    ap.add_argument("--audition", nargs=3, metavar=("ROLE", "ID", "VOLUME"),
                    help="also write audition.lua for one candidate")
    a = ap.parse_args()

    data = json.loads(Path(a.candidates).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    spec = [
        {"role": r["role"], "ids": [c["id"] for c in r["candidates"]]}
        for r in data["roles"]
        if r["candidates"]
    ]
    if not spec:
        raise SystemExit("no candidates in " + a.candidates)

    out = Path(a.out)
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    (out / "probe.lua").write_text(PROBE.replace("{spec}", luau_table(spec)), encoding="utf-8")
    (out / "report.lua").write_text(REPORT, encoding="utf-8")

    n = sum(len(r["ids"]) for r in spec)
    print(f"{out/'probe.lua'}   creates {n} sounds across {len(spec)} roles")
    print(f"{out/'report.lua'}  reads IsLoaded + TimeLength")

    if a.audition:
        role, aid, vol = a.audition
        text = (AUDITION.replace("{role}", f'"{role}"')
                        .replace("{id}", str(int(aid)))
                        .replace("{volume}", str(float(vol))))
        (out / "audition.lua").write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"{out/'audition.lua'} plays {role}/{aid} at volume {vol}")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

# Звуки Roblox: поиск, измерение и сборка банка

# Адаптация SyphoDev для мастерской

Выборочная адаптация исходного навыка для Roblox Automation. Точная неизменённая upstream-версия находится в UPSTREAM.md. Исходники в resources/ являются справочными; запускать их только в workspace активной native-задачи с отключённой сетью.

## Граница изменений

Изменять игру может только агент действительно запущенной задачи мастерской и только через её контролируемые инструменты. Соблюдать очередь, утверждённые стиль, механики и данные проекта. Не обходить очередь, не публиковать автоматически и не выполнять платежи. В одном проекте должен быть один Studio writer. Не использовать .claude/, Claude agents/orchestrators, LOCAL.md, model roster, sessions, отдельные очереди, установщики или внешние генераторы, Cloudflare, Kaggle, Pollinations и их ключи.

Офлайн Python запускать только внутри workspace активной native-задачи с отключённой сетью. Изменения сцены и проверки в Studio выполнять только через контролируемые workshop MCP вызовы этой задачи. Не запускать произвольные Studio команды из shell.

## Sound workflow

For planning/spec tasks without bound Studio, record sound requirements and unverified assumptions only. In the active native task, search candidates through controlled workshop.search_sfx(query, limit); its compact results are the source of candidate IDs and metadata.

Before running offline helpers, normalize the tool result to the shape expected by emit_probe.py and pick.py: {name, roles:[{role, query, kind, min_len, max_len, volume, looped, candidates:[{id, name, creator, audioType, score, listed_duration}]}]}. Map each task role's query and constraints from the approved sound spec. Convert string IDs only when they are safe positive integers. If search_sfx supplies no score, set score to negative array rank solely to preserve stable order; do not present that as a relevance or quality score. Keep listed_duration as a listing claim, never as a measured duration.

Offline commands in the active task workspace: python resources/scripts/emit_probe.py <candidates.json> --out <workspace-probes>; use its generated Luau only as a starting point. It targets SoundService.SFXProbe and clears that folder, so do not execute it unchanged. Adapt a task-owned copy to use a unique __SyphoSkillProbe_<task-id> folder, create it only if absent, never clear or alter existing SFXProbe, and include only the bounded candidate IDs. Run each measurement in a separate controlled workshop MCP execute_luau call. Record one CSV row per result as role,id,loaded,length using actual IsLoaded and Sound.TimeLength: python resources/scripts/pick.py <candidates.json> <report.csv> --out <manifest.json>.

Then run python resources/scripts/emit_bank.py <manifest.json> --out <workspace-bank>. It may create install.lua as an output file; do not execute or submit that file unless a separate task explicitly authorizes installation. Listen to selected sounds in Studio in a separate controlled step. Never call upstream find_sfx.py or use network search from shell.

---
name: roblox-sfx
description: Source, verify and wire the sound for a Roblox game from the Creator Store by asset id - footsteps, gunshots, animal calls, UI clicks, ambience, music - with no upload, no Open Cloud audio quota and no API key. Searches the same unauthenticated toolbox endpoints Studio's own audio tab uses, then PROVES each candidate in Studio (IsLoaded plus a measured Sound.TimeLength) before anything is chosen, because the toolbox's own duration field is wrong often enough to be dangerous. Emits a SoundBank data module, an Sfx runtime helper that fails inert, and an install script so the bank can be heard in an open place immediately. Use whenever the user wants sound effects, audio, SFX, music or ambience for a Roblox game, wants sounds found and wired rather than dragged in by hand, is picking audio for a build, or asks why a Sound is silent, has no length, or will not load in their place.
---

# Roblox sound, by id, verified

> **First time on this machine?** Read `LOCAL.md` in this folder. If it does not exist, run the
> `roblox-skills-setup` skill (or copy `LOCAL.template.md` to `LOCAL.md` and fill it in).
> `LOCAL.md` holds your paths and tool locations; it is yours and is never shared.

The whole skill rests on one fact, measured not assumed:

> **A free Creator Store audio asset plays in an unpublished, unsaved place, with
> no API key, no ownership and no upload.**

So sound does not need the Open Cloud audio quota (10 uploads/month unverified,
100 ID-verified, create-only, so every regeneration burns a slot). It needs a
search and a check. That takes the audio stage off the critical path entirely.

```
spec.json  (roles: what the game needs a sound FOR)
  -> find_sfx.py     unauthenticated toolbox search -> candidates.json
  -> emit_probe.py   probe.lua + report.lua
  -> Studio          create the Sounds, then MEASURE them   <- the gate
  -> pick.py         three gates, then score -> manifest.json
  -> emit_bank.py    SoundBank.luau + Sfx.luau + install.lua + tour.lua
```

Search produces **candidates**. Studio produces **facts**. Only facts choose.

---

## What was measured, and when

Verified live against Studio on 2026-08-30 in an unsaved `Place1`
(`placeId 0`) with the third-party `robloxstudio-mcp` connected:

| Question | Answer |
|---|---|
| Does `toolbox-service/v1/marketplace/3` need auth? | **No.** 200, 1000 results for `footstep` |
| Does `items/details` need auth? | **No.** Full metadata including `audioType`, artist, votes, `isFree` |
| Can you download the audio file to analyse it? | **No.** `assetdelivery` v1 and v2 both 401 |
| Does an unowned free audio id load in an unpublished place? | **Yes.** 40 of 40 candidates `IsLoaded = true` |
| Does `Sound:Play()` work in edit mode? | **Yes**, audible in Studio, no playtest needed |
| Is the toolbox `duration` field trustworthy? | **No.** A real 0.500s sound is listed as `0`; 2 of 8 shipped picks had a listing that disagreed with the measurement |

The fourth row is why selection cannot be clever. There is no waveform to
analyse, no spectrogram to look at, nothing to judge by ear from here. What
exists is a listing and a measurement, and the skill is honest about using only
those.

---

## The rule that shapes everything

**A listing is a claim. `Sound.TimeLength` is a measurement. Never gate on a claim.**

`find_sfx.py` deliberately stores the listing's duration under the name
`listed_duration` so that nothing downstream can mistake it for data, and
`pick.py` records `listing_was_wrong` on any pick where the two disagreed by
more than 25%. On the first real run that fired on 2 of 8.

---

## Two Studio calls, never one

`execute_luau` drops all output if the script yields at all, and a Sound does not
resolve its length in the frame you set `SoundId`. So the probe is split:

```
call 1   probe.lua    creates every candidate Sound, returns immediately
         (a beat)
call 2   report.lua   returns role,id,loaded,length as CSV
```

If anything is still `loaded=false` in call 2, run `report.lua` **once more**
before believing it. Only a second failure is a real one, and a real one means
an unresolvable id, a deleted asset, or audio this place is not permitted to use.

---

## The three gates

A candidate is only eligible once Studio says all three, in order:

1. **`IsLoaded == true`** — the id resolves and the place may use it
2. **`TimeLength > 0`** — a zero-length sound is broken, not short
3. **`min_len <= TimeLength <= max_len`** — the role's band

Search score breaks ties, and only ties. A top-ranked listing that fails a gate
always loses to a bottom-ranked one that passes. On the first run this rejected
a 6.55s "wooden gate open" from a role whose band ended at 5s.

**An unfilled role is a failure, not a warning.** `emit_bank.py` refuses to emit
a bank with holes; overriding needs an explicit `--allow-holes`, which means
deliberately shipping a silent event.

---

## Writing a spec

One entry per thing the game needs a sound **for**, never per sound you imagine.

```json
{
 "name": "farm",
 "roles": [
  { "name": "sheep_bleat", "query": "sheep bleat", "kind": "SoundEffect",
    "min_len": 0.3, "max_len": 4.0, "volume": 0.5 },
  { "name": "ambience",    "query": "countryside ambience", "kind": "Music",
    "min_len": 20, "max_len": 300, "volume": 0.2, "looped": true }
 ]
}
```

- `kind` is `SoundEffect` or `Music`. It is a real field on the asset and a
  mismatch is scored down hard, because a Music track answering a `SoundEffect`
  role is the classic way a nine-minute remix ends up as a footstep.
- The band is the design decision. A footstep over 1.5s is not a footstep, and
  writing that down is what lets the machine reject without hearing anything.
- `volume` and `looped` travel through to the emitted bank.

An example spec is in `examples/spec.example.json`; copy it and edit the roles.

---

## Run it

```bash
cd ~/.claude/skills/roblox-sfx
python scripts/find_sfx.py spec examples/spec.example.json --out work/candidates.json --per-role 5
python scripts/emit_probe.py work/candidates.json --out work
# execute_luau work/probe.lua      -> "created N sounds across M roles"
# execute_luau work/report.lua     -> save the return value verbatim to work/report.txt
python scripts/pick.py work/candidates.json work/report.txt --out work/manifest.json
python scripts/emit_bank.py work/manifest.json --out work
# execute_luau work/install.lua    -> SoundService.SFX, audible in this place
# execute_luau work/tour.lua       -> plays the whole bank in order, so a human can judge it
```

A one-off lookup, no spec needed:

```bash
python scripts/find_sfx.py search --query "wolf howl" --kind SoundEffect --limit 20
```

---

## What ships

| File | Goes to | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `SoundBank.luau` | `src/shared/Config/` | Data only: role -> id, measured length, volume, looped, credit |
| `Sfx.luau` | `src/shared/` | `Sfx.play(role, parent, pitchVary)`, `Sfx.preload()`, `Sfx.stop()` |
| `install.lua` | `execute_luau` | Builds `SoundService.SFX` directly, for a place with no Rojo sync |
| `tour.lua` | `execute_luau` | Plays every sound in order, spaced by its real length |

Two rules the emitted code keeps:

- **Nothing outside the bank ever names an asset id.** Gameplay code says
  `Sfx.play("wolf_howl", head)`. Retuning volume or swapping an asset is a data
  edit, never a code edit.
- **Sound can never break gameplay.** Every entry point in `Sfx.luau` is
  pcall-isolated and returns nil on failure. A missing sound must not stop a shot
  from firing or a sheep from moving.

`tour.lua` schedules with `task.delay` rather than looping with `task.wait`, for
the same reason the probe is split in two: a yielding script loses its output.

---

## Traps

**The listing duration is wrong.** Covered above. It is the single most likely
thing to make this pipeline ship a bad sound if someone "optimises" the Studio
round trip away.

**`search_assets` on the MCP is a dead end.** It returns HTTP 403 `Scope not
authorized`, and no renaming of parameters fixes it. That is why this skill goes
straight to the toolbox endpoints, which need no auth at all.

**You cannot hear anything, and neither can the model.** `assetdelivery` is 401
without a cookie, so there is no waveform, no spectrogram, no loudness figure.
Everything this skill claims about a sound comes from the listing or from
`TimeLength`. When taste matters, run `tour.lua` and let a human judge. For an
unattended run, the gates plus the score are the honest ceiling, and that is a
finding worth saying out loud rather than papering over.

**Free packs are not the same as free audio.** A free Creator Store *pack* is not
loadable until a human takes it into the account (learned the hard way on the VFX
harvester). Individual audio assets used by id have no such step, which is exactly
why this skill works by id and never asks anyone to take anything.

**Volume 0 during probing is deliberate.** 40 candidate sounds resolving at once
in an open Studio would be unpleasant. `probe.lua` sets `Volume = 0`;
`audition.lua`, `install.lua` and `tour.lua` set the real volume.

**Roblox's own stock library scores a deliberate bonus.** Creator id 1 assets
(the `91207…`-shaped ids) are consistent, always permitted and never deleted. If
a run must be reproducible months later, prefer them.

---

## Why library selection and not generated audio

Selecting from the library needs no quota, no ID verification, no moderation
wait and no upload, and an agent searching and selecting from the Creator Store
needs no human intervention.

Generated audio would burn a create-only upload quota to produce something no one
in the loop can hear. That trade is not worth making, and this skill is the
argument.
